limits: Trust frozen before raw artifact access, after CI measurements began.

Raw physical IPC inputs and all three arms’ golden arrays are replayed independently. All three arms’ query golden arrays are retained at both thread settings and independently replayed. Timed final arrays are not duplicated: exact source-bound final checks/hashes are bound to each arm golden. All three complete corpus arrays are independently replayed.
C corpus uses historical tolerance1e-10, integer outputs exact; native corpus requires exact finite/signed-zero/masks/NaN positions. NaN sign/payload not a public guarantee.

Shared-target Cargo metadata/fingerprints/dependency edges/portable flags are inspected but are not a unique cryptographic ELF-to-linked-rlib bridge; source/wheel binding includes exact actual compile logs and immutable workflow execution.
Twelve process rounds and correlated inner samples are descriptive, not formal multiple-comparison significance; no pooling thread settings/runners.
Fault counters cover engine/Python/allocator activity across query threads, not allocator-only events.

Direct-window SMA oracle uses the declared C1e-10 real policy; EMA/WMA controls rely on actual C query goldens. Native prior/candidate goldens are compared exactly, including finite/signedzero/masks/NaN/infinity positions.

No actual normal-wheel helper bounds-removal static claim is made here: actual ELF identities are checked, while the changed checked-zip source mechanism is bound to reviewed immutable helper bytes. Source/static motivation is distinct from measured latency.
